reason: The hypothesis makes specific mechanistic claims about lattice distortion and solid solution strengthening in HEAs, but cites no prior evidence to support any of its key premises. Standard textbook knowledge does not cover the specific role of severe lattice distortion in equiatomic HEAs, so citations are needed.
premises: Hardness and strength in single-phase equiatomic HEAs are governed by solid solution strengthening.
Severe lattice distortion is the primary driver of this strengthening.
Greater atomic size mismatch creates higher strain fields.
These strain fields hinder dislocation motion.
Increased lattice distortion leads to higher hardness and yield strength.
